title: Attention Semantic Motion and Visual Storytelling Quality
research_question: Do host-grounded softmax weights drive actual animated geometry and value transport into a context, with native decoded-frame evidence beyond three visually different static SceneGraphs?
scope: OFFLINE_HOST_ONLY, zero inference, no new GPT model authoring; one attention teaching family
selection_rule: freeze two 2-token single-head attention examples from the same QKV basis, first Q=[1,0], heldout Q=[0,1], value vectors V_A=[1,0], V_B=[0,1]
mandatory_truth: weights exactly softmax(scores), nonnegative and sum to 1
visual bar widths and transported area derived from same weights
displayed numbers derived from host facts and bound SHA
counterfactual reversing query changes larger bar and resulting context in corresponding direction
quality_goals: narration beat alignment at segment level
reuse existing V2 SceneGraph + V3-51 factual ledger concepts and original sandbox
no constant template-fallback that pretends to be model scene
